title: allium carinatum var. flexum
intro: Allium carinatum var. flexum, commonly known as keel-flowered rock garlic, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Allium genus, characterized by its distinctive, bell-shaped flowers and strong onion-like fragrance. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties, and also shows potential in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of keel-flowered rock garlic include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and may have anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties.
